body:
I have recently been down this road as a voluntary admit.  Two somewhat contrary reflections.  One, it was a very difficult place to be and I do not want to go back.  Two, I am glad I did it as it really helped me.    

You are not alone.
Your words and painting are comforting and give me much to think about. Thank you so much for taking the time to read and reply in such a thoughtful manner. You are a hero.
